mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, sender_id, content) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id <> #{userId} AND id > COALESCE(#{lastReadMessageId}, 0)
SELECT MIN(id) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id <> #{userId} AND id > COALESCE(#{lastReadMessageId}, 0)
